deadline.value: All materials by December 15, 2026; late letters may mean the file is not reviewed.
deadline.quote: The application deadline is December 15th 2026, for all application materials.

gre_general.value: General GRE scores are not considered.
gre_general.quote: Only the GRE MATH Subject scores will be considered, the General GRE scores will not be considered.

gre_subject.value: GRE Mathematics Subject score of 600 or above is required; applications without it, or below 600, are not reviewed.
gre_subject.quote: GRE MATH Subject Score: Required 600 or above. Applications without a GRE MATH Subject score or with a score below 600 will not be reviewed for admission.

supervisor.value: Not stated on the official pages fetched.

funding.value: Every PhD student making satisfactory progress receives full support (TA, fellowship or GRA), usually with summer support.
funding.quote: Every Graduate student who is making satisfactory progress towards the Ph.D. degree in mathematics, receives full financial support

entry_route.value: Applicants must show mastery of an undergraduate mathematics major.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must demonstrate mastery of the material required for an undergraduate major in mathematics.

notes: Applied Mathematics (Center for Applied Mathematics) is a separate PhD field with a December 15 deadline and no GRE; applicants may apply to only one of the two in a term.
